mekanism_robit.constraints: Requires owning team to have Robit item access and recipe access; offline owner supported by FTB team manager ID lookup, not player presence

create_potion_mixing.identity_storage: Weak references with identity hash/equality and reference-queue cleanup; no recipe/world strong retention, registrations survive server-script reload while native caches retain their list
create_potion_mixing.classification: Reinspect all item ingredient alternatives/results and all fluid alternatives/results for every operation, using current item stage policy; no stale stage cache
create_potion_mixing.vanilla: Generated native vanilla potion contents open at epoch15; lingering bottles require epoch30
create_potion_mixing.quarantine: Unknown recipe identities, modded potion holder namespaces, custom effects, unknown fluid IDs, unknown data components, empty or unsupported shapes remain stage100
create_potion_mixing.fluids: Only actual minecraft:water or create:potion; PotionContents and create:potion_fluid_bottle_type inspected, never a generic potion-fluid ID allowlist bypass
